title: Mission Control projects
description: The projects that have a snapshot (#99), in the order of the settings. A project is listed only when <id>/snapshot.json exists next to this file, and its name is that snapshot's project name. The web app reads this list instead of a hard-coded one. Ids are unique (checked by the collector and the web app; JSON Schema cannot express it).

schemaVersion.description: Version of this contract. Bumped only for breaking changes.

id.description: Unique; also the folder of the project's files and the first part of its URL (e.g. mission-control).
